case.message: Compare Apple annual revenue and net income before and after November 10, 2023. Explain whether management outlook passages can actually be tested using the retrieved financial metrics.

data.response:
# Apple Annual Revenue and Net Income Investigation

**Insufficient evidence**

AAPL revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $391.035 billion [E6abfb08af8](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), up from $383.285 billion for 2023-09-30 [Ed8cac20176](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). AAPL net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $93.736 billion [Ee01b580849](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), down from $96.995 billion for 2023-09-30 [E0d8b9d496d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). AAPL cash PP&E purchases for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $9.447 billion [E4b4a831d0c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), down from $10.959 billion for 2023-09-30 [Ec428ad2b43](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of November 10, 2023, original reported financial results for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023, were known, showing annual revenue of 383,285,000,000 USD [E7532e0e910](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html) and net income of 96,995,000,000 USD [Eb756fc8ccf](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). For the prior fiscal year ended September 24, 2022, revenue was 394,328,000,000 USD [E75055f781e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html) and net income was 99,803,000,000 USD [E0563059dfa](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html). Management outlook records were absent from the database as of the baseline date [E6821590ed0].

## What happened later

In subsequent filings through March 1, 2025, Apple reported annual revenue of 391,035,000,000 USD for the fiscal period ending September 28, 2024 [E6abfb08af8](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html). Net income for the same fiscal period ending September 28, 2024, was reported as 93,736,000,000 USD [Ee01b580849](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html). Operating income shifted from 114,301,000,000 USD for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023 [E8e61081ba5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html) to 123,216,000,000 USD for the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024 [E022faf9dba](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html). Operating cash flow changed from 110,543,000,000 USD for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023 [E8cb175551d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html) to 118,254,000,000 USD for the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024 [E4cb106cc44](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html).

## The peer test

Only AAPL was selected. Add a peer company to compare results.

## Cross-examination

Management outlook passages cannot be tested because no matching records for management claims were found in the date-bounded source for AAPL as of November 10, 2023 [E6821590ed0]. Without retrieved forecast statements, any comparison between historical financial outcomes and management intent is not testable. Subsequent financial results alone do not verify unrecorded management promises.

## Limits

- Management outlook claims are missing from the date-bounded source, preventing the testability analysis.
- As-of vintage macroeconomic series are unavailable due to reliance on revised historical series.
- No peer companies or peer comparisons were specified or retrieved for AAPL.
